description: This file initializes and renders the root React component in a web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component, then mounts the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' using React 18's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node for rendering
methods.usage: Initializes the React rendering context for the application

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM node
methods.usage: Mounts the React component into the DOM
